Answer a few questions and we'll recommend
a plan that fits your usage pattern.
Onboarding.guestCaption: Guests can try some AI recommendation features first.

questions.title:
Which type best matches
your mobile usage style?
questions.description: There's no right answer. Choose the one closest to you.

options.title: I use a lot of data
options.description: I often watch videos, use social media, and stream content

options.title: I make the most of benefits
options.description: I often use membership and discount benefits

options.title: I want to lower my mobile bill
options.description: I want to use only what I need and save money

options.title: I'd like AI to recommend for me
options.description: I want recommendations based on my usage patterns

questions.title:
How much mobile data
do you usually use each month?
questions.description: Choose the range closest to your typical usage.

options.title: Less than 10GB
options.description: I mainly use messaging and web browsing

options.title: 10GB – 50GB
options.description: I regularly use social media and watch videos

options.title: More than 50GB
options.description: I frequently watch videos and stream content

options.title: I need unlimited data
options.description: I don't want to worry about how much data I use

questions.title:
What kind of content do you
enjoy most on your phone?
questions.description: Choose the service you use most often.

options.title: Video · OTT
options.description: I often watch YouTube, Netflix, and other video services

options.title: Social media · Communities
options.description: I often use social media and online communities

options.title: Games
options.description: I often play mobile games

options.title: Messaging · Web browsing
options.description: I mainly use basic smartphone features

questions.title:
Which carrier benefit
matters most to you?
questions.description: Choose the benefit that appeals to you most.

options.title: Membership discounts
options.description: I value discounts for cafés, movies, and dining

options.title: OTT · Content
options.description: I prefer video and content subscription benefits

options.title: Coupons · Partner benefits
options.description: I like benefits I can use in everyday life

options.title: Benefits aren't that important
options.description: Price and data conditions matter more to me

questions.title:
What matters most when
you choose a mobile plan?
questions.description: Tell us what you usually prioritize when choosing a plan.

options.title: Low price
options.description: I want to keep my monthly mobile bill as low as possible

options.title: Balance of price and data
options.description: I want enough data at a reasonable price

options.title: More benefits
options.description: The benefits I receive matter more than the price

options.title: The best overall conditions
options.description: I prioritize data and services over price

questions.title:
Lastly, what kind of plan
would you like us to recommend?
questions.description: We'll prioritize this when generating your AI recommendation.

options.title: The most affordable plan
options.description: I want the cheapest plan that fits my usage

options.title: A plan with plenty of data
options.description: I want to use data without worrying about running out

options.title: A plan with lots of benefits
options.description: I want plenty of membership and partner benefits

options.title: Let AI choose for me
options.description: Consider price, data, and benefits together

PersonaResult.title: You're a {type}
PersonaResult.startChat: Chat with AI using this result

data.name: Data Heavy Type
data.description: You use a lot of data and value having plenty of data available.
data.directionDescription: We'll look for a plan that comfortably covers your usage without unnecessarily increasing your monthly cost.

content.name: Content Lover Type
content.description: You frequently enjoy video and OTT services and get strong value from content-related benefits.
content.directionDescription: We'll consider both your content usage and subscription benefits to find a plan that gives you better overall value.

benefit.name: Benefit Saver Type
benefit.description: You actively use carrier benefits such as memberships, discounts, and partner offers.
benefit.directionDescription: We'll look for plans that maximize the membership and partner benefits you are most likely to use.

saving.name: Smart Saver Type
saving.description: You want enough data for your needs while keeping your monthly mobile bill as low as possible.
saving.summary: Price focused / only what you need
saving.directionDescription: We'll reduce unnecessary data and benefits and focus on economical plans that fit your actual usage.

balanced.name: Balanced Content Type
balanced.description: You value an overall balance between data, benefits, and monthly price rather than focusing on just one.
balanced.directionDescription: We'll consider price, data, and benefits together to find the plan that best matches your overall usage pattern.
